question: Which of the following Vedas is found in two recensions, black and white, and is full of rituals to be performed publicly or individually?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yajurveda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yajurveda:-**

 
 
• **The Yajurveda is the Veda primarily of prose mantras for worship rituals. **
 
• It is one of the four Vedas, the Hindu scriptures that are considered to be the oldest sacred texts of Hinduism.
 
• **The Yajurveda is compiled with ritual-offering formulas that were said by a priest while an individual performed ritual actions such as those before the Yajna fire.**
 
• The Yajurveda is also one of the scriptures of Hinduism.
 
• **The Veda that is found in two recensions, black and white, and is full of rituals to be performed publicly or individually is the Yajurveda.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Rigveda**:-

 
 
• **It is the oldest and most important of the four Vedas. **
 
• It is a collection of over 1,000 hymns that were composed over a period of centuries, most likely between 1500 and 1200 BCE.
 
• The hymns are dedicated to a variety of deities, including Indra, Agni, and Soma.
 
• The Rigveda is considered to be one of the most important texts in Hindu literature. It is a source of information about early Indian culture and religion.
 
 
 
• **Atharvaveda:-**
 
 
• **It is the fourth and youngest of the four Vedas. **
 
• It is a collection of hymns and spells that are used for a variety of purposes, including healing, protection, and cursing.
 
• The Atharvaveda is considered to be a practical Veda, as it deals with the everyday concerns of life.
 
• It is also a source of information about Indian folk medicine and magic.
 
 
 
• **Samaveda:-**
 
 
• **It is the third of the four Vedas. **
 
• It is a collection of hymns that are set to music.
 
• The hymns are derived from the Rigveda, but they are set to a different melody.
 
• The Samaveda is considered to be the Veda of music, and it is used in Hindu rituals. It is also a source of information about Indian music theory and practice.
